empty_today_body: No tasks due today. Tap + to add one.
empty_all_body: Tap the + button to add your first household task.
error_body: Something went wrong while loading your tasks.
tutorial_step1_body: Tasks are grouped by time of day so the morning crew sees morning tasks, evening crew sees evening tasks. Filters at the top let you narrow to today, this week, or just your own.
tutorial_step2_title: Tap the circle to mark done
tutorial_step2_body: When a task is done, just tap the circle. Recurring tasks will pop back up automatically — you don't have to recreate them.
tutorial_step3_title: Add a task with the + button
tutorial_step3_body: Tap the orange + at the bottom. Give it a title, pick who's doing it, when it's due, and how often it repeats. That's it.
